integrity: The extremal deduction uses the published 2020 Theorem 3.1 together with the classical Hall theorem that regular p-groups have Omega_1 equal to the set of elements killed by p and that class less than p implies regularity. The sharpness calculation for C_p wr C_p is derived directly from its semidirect-product multiplication. Bounded exhaustive enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the exact second maximum in the regular class and for all p-groups only through orders p^p.
For order p^(p+1) and above, the wreath product proves the regular bound is no longer global but is not claimed to be extremal.
The regularity input is classical; the new claim is the sharp extremal cutoff and boundary calculation.
title: A sharp order cutoff for the second cyclic-subgroup maximum of odd prime-power groups
